limitations: Quality-related fields are keyword-based candidates; undocumented flag meanings are not inferred.
Operational/context flags are reported separately from quality-related candidates.
Measurement uncertainty fields are reported separately and are not converted into a quality score.
Values outside XML-declared limits are flagged for review, not automatically classified as scientifically invalid.
Special Constants are matched only against explicitly documented XML values using exact trimmed text.
Special Constant matches are kept separate from blank or generic missing values and non-numeric values.
When one value matches multiple documented Special Constant types, it is recorded as an ambiguous match.
A field may appear in more than one report category when it meets multiple independent selection rules.
Distinct-value tracking is bounded in memory. When capped, the reported distinct count is a lower bound.
Duplicate XML names and known WS aliases are mapped only under narrowly validated positional conditions.
Ambiguous column mappings are not used for measurement calculations.
This analyzer does not determine overall instrument health or scientific suitability of a period.
